comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Small rural Alaska hydro electric utility mixed with telephone and broadband; telecom exposure and remote-market economics differ from Con Edison's urban multi-utility.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility; different commodity and regulatory economics than electric, gas and steam delivery.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Regulated integrated electric and natural gas utility serving residential, commercial and industrial customers; closely matches Con Edison's core business.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Upstream gas producer with unregulated commodity sales and carbon capture; not a regulated delivery utility.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mostly gas distribution and pipelines with sizable propane and marketing; small electric business and different mix, though partly overlapping.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility in Arizona; different service than electric, gas and steam delivery.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Regulated gas distribution utility with clean energy investments, similar to Con Edison's gas business; wholesale marketing is a difference.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Regulated natural gas distribution utility selling to residential and commercial customers, matching Con Edison's gas delivery business.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Unregulated retail propane and fuel oil distributor with HVAC services; not a regulated network utility.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Regulated electric transmission and distribution utility holding company serving residential, commercial and industrial customers, like Con Edison's electric business.
